contracts.commit_point: Per tool, the sign-then-broadcast pair culminating in w3.eth.send_raw_transaction: tools.py:51-55 (transfer_eth), tools.py:328-331 (transfer_token), tools.py:380-383 (approve_token), tools.py:513-514 (deploy_erc20_token).
contracts.declared_mechanism: OpenAI Agents SDK input guardrail: prompt_guardrail runs prompt_guardrail_agent via Runner.run over the incoming input, converts PromptAnalysis.is_safe into GuardrailFunctionOutput.tripwire_triggered (guardrails.py:18-21), and returns tripwire_triggered=True on any exception (guardrails.py:24-26, fail-closed). It is registered on triage_agent via input_guardrails=[prompt_guardrail] (blockchain_agents.py:94); triage_agent is the entry agent for Runner.run_streamed in the Chainlit on_message handler (chainlit_handlers.py:23) and hands off to the transaction agents (blockchain_agents.py:93), so a tripped tripwire halts the run before agent processing, handoff, or tool execution.
contracts.forbidden_condition: An unsafe or out-of-scope user prompt — i.e., one for which prompt_guardrail_agent yields PromptAnalysis.is_safe=False, or whose guardrail analysis raises an exception (fail-closed trip) — being admitted into a triage_agent run such that the run can proceed to agent-invoked write tools that sign with PRI_KEY and broadcast on-chain transactions via w3.eth.send_raw_transaction.

contracts.protected_operation: Agent tool invocation of the four write tools: transfer_eth (src/components/tools.py:11-61), transfer_token (src/components/tools.py:286-336), approve_token (src/components/tools.py:338-388), and deploy_erc20_token (src/components/tools.py:390-556), each of which performs w3.eth.account.sign_transaction(tx, private_key=PRI_KEY) followed by w3.eth.send_raw_transaction(signed_tx.raw_transaction).
contracts.protected_resource: The PRI_KEY-controlled Ethereum account and the BSC testnet (chainId 97) on-chain ledger state reachable via w3, including ETH/ERC20 balances mutated by transfers, ERC20 allowances created by approvals, and newly deployed ERC20 contract state.
contracts.protection_obligation: The input guardrail prompt_guardrail (@input_guardrail-decorated, src/components/guardrails.py:6-27), registered on triage_agent via input_guardrails=[prompt_guardrail] (src/components/blockchain_agents.py:94), must trip (GuardrailFunctionOutput with tripwire_triggered=not final_output.is_safe, and fail-closed tripwire_triggered=True on any analysis exception) to halt unsafe or out-of-scope user prompts at entry to the agent run — the run started via Runner.run_streamed(triage_agent, input=chat_history) in the Chainlit on_message handler — before that run can proceed (including via handoffs to native_tx_agent and smart_contract_tx_agent) to the blockchain write tools transfer_eth, transfer_token, approve_token, and deploy_erc20_token, which sign transactions with PRI_KEY and broadcast them via w3.eth.send_raw_transaction.
scope_limits: The guard is registered only on triage_agent (blockchain_agents.py:94); blockchain_query_agent, native_tx_agent, and smart_contract_tx_agent declare no input_guardrails, so coverage depends on every run entering through the guardrailed triage_agent (chainlit_handlers.py:23).

The obligation covers on-chain write broadcasts only; other effects inside deploy_erc20_token — install_solc (tools.py:424) and the BscScan source-verification POST (tools.py:524-538) — occur downstream of the same guard but are not the named protected effect of this obligation.

Instruction-level requirements to summarize transaction details and request user confirmation before write transactions (e.g., blockchain_agents.py:15, 50, 66, 86; tools.py:18-19, 293-294, 345-346) are prompt guidance to the model, not enforceable code guards, and are outside this contract.

Read-only tools (eth_get_balance, eth_get_transaction_count, eth_get_code, eth_gas_price, token_get_balance, token_get_info; blockchain_agents.py:37) are not gated write effects under this obligation.
The safety/scope classification itself is delegated to prompt_guardrail_agent; this contract asserts the trip-and-halt wiring, not the correctness or coverage of that classification.

Effect stratum other_external is chosen because the guarded effect is irreversible broadcast/mutation of third-party blockchain ledger state via RPC, which fits none of http/file/database/process/communication/state/tool_execution as its primary effect class.
